name: 01-cover-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star golden-hour pursuit on Ocean Boulevard: the clearcoat Solaris GT drifts across wet reflective asphalt toward an SBPD roadblock (two cruisers nose-in in a V, striped sawhorses, burning red flares, officers firing), UNIT-12 grinding sparks off its rear quarter for the PIT and UNIT-07 flanking on the beach side, while Air One holds it in the searchlight. Civilian traffic waits at the barricade and the pavements scatter. The live SBPD RESPONSE · 6 UNITS table lists AIR ONE · SPOTLIGHT, UNIT-12 · PIT/RAM, UNIT-07 · FLANKING, TAC-04 · ROADBLOCK, UNIT-21 · CLOSING IN and UNIT-33 · INTERCEPT with distances. The HUD shows the IN SIGHT · AIR ONE LOCKED pill, the five-slot weapon rail, the Z / X / C crew ability cards with portraits and live cooldowns, labelled HEALTH and ARMOR, PALM STRIP · RESPECTED 72, STAGE 3/4 with the NEXT: step, CONDITION 86%, the radio and Mateo on the dialogue line.

name: 02-on-foot-heist.jpg
caption: Neon twilight at the Solaris Vault plaza: the player kneels in low cover behind the teal Coastal Muscle firing an SMG over the boot, Mateo kneels off the nose laying cyan covering fire, armoured guards return fire, one guard is down and civilians run with their hands up. The IN COVER chip and the [F] STEAL COASTAL MUSCLE prompt sit above Mateo's dialogue, and the SBPD RESPONSE · 3 UNITS table tracks OFC-31 · FOOT CHASE, UNIT-12 · CLOSING IN and TAC-04 · ROADBLOCK. Weapon rail, crew cards (JAM DISPATCH cooling), HEALTH / ARMOR and NEON MIDTOWN · KNOWN 38 frame the fight.

name: 03-city-map-menu.jpg
caption: The city menu (M) at night: the organic seven-district coastal map of Solaris Bay with the GPS route, police blips and district tints, the District Standing panel with its passive income, and a 64.2% COMPLETE ring in the header. The side panel lists all eight story jobs with G / S / B medals, the deployed crew as portrait cards, side activities with medals and personal bests, garage upgrade stages, and three inline save cards (SLOT 1-3) with working SAVE and LOAD buttons beside the highlighted SAVES tab.

name: 04-title-screen.jpg
caption: The start screen at golden hour: a high aerial looking west down Ocean Boulevard into the sun, with hotels and neon on one side and the beach, Coral Pier and the bay on the other, under the sunset SOLARIS BAY lockup. The menu offers CONTINUE, NEW GAME, LOAD GAME and CONTROLS & SETTINGS, the right panel shows three live save-slot cards (SLOT 1 · ACT II — NEON HEIST · 42% · $41,280 · PALM STRIP, SLOT 2 · ACT I — HARBOR CONTRABAND · 18%, SLOT 3 · EMPTY) and a key footer runs along the bottom.
